name: Codestra service identity: grafana-runtime
description: Confidential machine identity for the monitoring plane. Reads Grafana datasource credentials, the Middleware observability read token and the Grafana OIDC client secret; reads Middleware operational views. Repository-only desired state applied to staging by the narrow OpenBao workload-identity reconciler; production binding requires the protected managed-client process.
